author: braindancing
description: Click to start the game and you can select easy, medium and hard modes respectively. You need to use the up, down, left, right and right arrows or ‘wasd’ to control the player's movement. Use space to control the player's jump, and ‘z’ to control the player's shooting. The red objects are the enemies that the player needs to destroy, and the green objects are the objects that the player needs to avoid. Players need to reach a certain score to be considered the game victory, if the middle of the collision with other obstacles will be considered as the game failed, click on the restart button to restart the game.
